title: Moorstrandbad Kirchbichl
highlights: One of Tyrol's oldest and most heritage-rich natural moor lidos, established in 1934
Pure restorative moor water scientifically proven to benefit skin and joints
Spacious sunbathing lawn nestled in shady pine woodland with a playground
Charming waterside tavern serving traditional Tyrolean home-style cuisine
kurzbeschreibung: Moorstrandbad Kirchbichl is one of Tirol's oldest outdoor pools, offering healing moor water amidst lush greenery.
beschreibung:
Healing Tradition in Green Surroundings

The Moorstrandbad Kirchbichl – affectionately known by locals as Waldbad – was opened back in 1934, making it one of the oldest and most traditional natural lidos in Tirol. The facility is fed by natural moor water, prized for its soothing and beneficial effects on the skin, muscles, and joints.

Relaxation for the Whole Family

The extensive lawn surrounded by mature trees offers plenty of shady spots on hot summer days. Younger bathers can enjoy a shallow shore area, a paddling pool, and a playground. The rustic lakeside restaurant treats visitors to hearty Tirolean delicacies and refreshing beverages.
